mapper.sql: SELECT TO_CHAR(A.AGREE_NO) AS AGREE_NO, A.AGREE_ID, A.AGREE_NAME, A.PERSON_ID, A.EMPID, A.LOCAL_NAME, GET_DEPT_NAME(H.DEPTNO, #{lang, jdbcType=VARCHAR}) AS DEPT_NAME, TO_CHAR(A.CON_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CON_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.CON_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS CON_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STUDY_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS STUDY_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.STUDY_DAY) AS STUDY_DAY, TO_CHAR(A.SERVICE_YEAR) AS SERVICE_YEAR, TO_CHAR(A.SER_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS SER_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.SER_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS SER_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.EXCHANGE_RATE) AS EXCHANGE_RATE, TO_CHAR(A.HQ_FREE) AS HQ_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.CGFY_FREE) AS CGFY_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.JP_FREE) AS JP_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.ZFBZ_FREE) AS ZFBZ_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.CGBZ_FREE) AS CGBZ_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.CGBZ_FREE_FACT) AS CGBZ_FREE_FACT, TO_CHAR(A.SYBX_FREE) AS SYBX_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.YX_PAY) AS YX_PAY, TO_CHAR(A.JT_FREE) AS JT_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.TX_FREE) AS TX_FREE, TO_CHAR(A.TOTAL_FEE) AS TOTAL_FEE, TO_CHAR(A.FACT_PAY) AS FACT_PAY, TO_CHAR(A.AGREE_START_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS AGREE_START_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.AGREE_END_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS AGREE_END_DATE, TO_CHAR(A.LEFT_DATE, 'DD/MM/YYYY') AS LEFT_DATE, A.REMARK FROM EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT A LEFT JOIN HR_EMPLOYEE H ON H.PERSON_ID = A.PERSON_ID
mapper.select:
WHERE A.ACTIVITY = '1' AND A.CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
AND H.DEPTNO IN (SELECT D.DEPTNO FROM HR_DEPARTMENT D START WITH D.DEPTNO = #{deptNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} CONNECT BY PRIOR D.DEPTNO = D.PARENT_DEPT_NO)
AND (A.EMPID = #{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR} OR CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(A.LOCAL_NAME)) LIKE '%' || CONVERTTOUNSIGN(UPPER(#{keyword, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) || '%')
AND A.CON_START_DATE >= TO_DATE(#{conStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
AND A.CON_END_DATE <= TO_DATE(#{conEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY')
ORDER BY A.CREATE_DATE DESC
SELECT NVL(MAX(TO_NUMBER(SUBSTR(AGREE_ID, 4))), 0) FROM EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT WHERE CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND REGEXP_LIKE(AGREE_ID, '^[A-Z]{3}[0-9]+$')
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT (AGREE_NO, PERSON_ID, LOCAL_NAME, EMPID, AGREE_ID, AGREE_NAME, SER_START_DATE, SER_END_DATE, TOTAL_FEE, EXCHANGE_RATE, HQ_FREE, CGFY_FREE, JP_FREE, ZFBZ_FREE, CGBZ_FREE, CGBZ_FREE_FACT, SYBX_FREE, YX_PAY, JT_FREE, TX_FREE, REMARK, FACT_PAY, LEFT_DATE, AGREE_START_DATE, AGREE_END_DATE, ACTIVITY, CREATE_DATE, CREATED_BY, CREATED_IP, CPNY_ID, STUDY_START_DATE, STUDY_END_DATE, STUDY_DAY, SERVICE_YEAR, CON_START_DATE, CON_END_DATE) VALUES (#{agreeNo, jdbcType=NUMERIC}, #{personId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{localName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{empId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agreeId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{agreeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{serStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{serEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{totalFee, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{exchangeRate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{hqFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cgfyFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jpFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{zfbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cgbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cgbzFreeFact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{sybxFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{yxPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{jtFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{txFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{factPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{leftDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{agreeStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{agreeEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), '1', SYSDATE, #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{studyStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{studyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), #{studyDay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{serviceYear, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TO_DATE(#{conStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), TO_DATE(#{conEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'))
mapper.update: UPDATE EDU_TRAIN_AGREEMENT SET AGREE_NAME = #{agreeName, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CON_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{conStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), CON_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{conEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{studyStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{studyEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), STUDY_DAY = #{studyDay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, HQ_FREE = #{hqFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGFY_FREE = #{cgfyFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JP_FREE = #{jpFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, ZFBZ_FREE = #{zfbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGBZ_FREE = #{cgbzFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, CGBZ_FREE_FACT = #{cgbzFreeFact, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYBX_FREE = #{sybxFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, YX_PAY = #{yxPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, JT_FREE = #{jtFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, TX_FREE = #{txFree, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, FACT_PAY = #{factPay, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, AGREE_START_DATE = TO_DATE(#{agreeStartDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), AGREE_END_DATE = TO_DATE(#{agreeEndDate, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'DD/MM/YYYY'), REMARK = #{remark, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATE_DATE = SYSDATE, UPDATED_BY = #{adminID, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, UPDATED_IP = #{adminIP, jdbcType=VARCHAR} WHERE AGREE_NO = #{agreeNo, jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND CPNY_ID = #{cpnyId, jdbcType=VARCHAR}
